current.text: He re-signed with Atlanta on a 1-year, 14 million USD deal.
He is Atlanta's backup center behind Onyeka Okongwu and part of an expected 10-man rotation.
Atlanta's center depth is thin: Veesaar is out for the season and Gueye is injured.
If Okongwu got hurt, he would start and play 30-plus minutes. That makes him the best stash on the team, but only in deep leagues.
One expert calls him an okay backup center and questions the price of his contract.
Atlanta's playoff schedule is 4-4-3 games for a March 28 end. The team has 14 back-to-backs and is not expected to rest players.

durable.text: He is a center who can shoot. With him, Atlanta always has a shooting center on the floor, which fits Quin Snyder's five-out offense.
He gets very few steals, even for a center.

note: Do not draft him in our auction. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 281, ESPN gives no value, and his projection (8.5 PTS, 4.7 REB, 0.2 BLK, 0.3 STL) is a bench line that will go well outside the 144 players drafted. His value depends on Okongwu's health: last season he played 22.2 minutes for 10.6 PTS and 5.7 REB, and with Veesaar out and Gueye hurt, an Okongwu injury would make him a 30-minute starter worth a quick FAB bid. Early in the season, check his minutes and when Gueye returns.
